Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.util

Record Class StoredFluid

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.util.StoredFluid
public record StoredFluid(net.minecraft.world.level.material.Fluid fluid, int amount, net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponentPatch components) extends Record
Loader-neutral fluid identity, amount in millibuckets, and variant components. The components use the same immutable DataComponentPatch form as NeoForge fluid stacks and Fabric fluid variants, so conversion at those loader boundaries is lossless.

    • isEmpty

      public boolean isEmpty()
      Returns whether this value has no usable fluid identity or positive amount.
      Returns:
      true when the fluid is Fluids.EMPTY or the amount is not positive

    • isSameVariant

      public boolean isSameVariant(StoredFluid other)
      Compares fluid identity and variant components while ignoring amount. Fluid aliases recognized by Fluid.isSame(net.minecraft.world.level.material.Fluid) compare as the same fluid.
      Parameters:
      other - value to compare against
      Returns:
      true when both fluids are the same and their components are equal

    • withAmount

      Returns:
      EMPTY for zero or negative amounts; otherwise a new value with the same components

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with '=='.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
